title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 114 Mill Street in Hookstown, Pennsylvania, as the "Staff Sergeant Dylan Elchin Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 114 Mill Street in Hookstown, Pennslyvania, as the "Staff Sergeant Dylan Elchin Post Office Building."

summary.headline: This law names the Hookstown, Pennsylvania post office building at 114 Mill Street after Staff Sergeant Dylan Elchin.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially designates the United States Postal Service facility at 114 Mill Street in Hookstown, Pennsylvania, as the "Staff Sergeant Dylan Elchin Post Office Building." It changes only the building's official name and does not change how mail is delivered or what services the office provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 3, 2020.
